title: I Won't Buy These Again
text: I Won't Buy These Again. These are the smallest "queen size" flannel sheets I've ever seen. If it weren't for the fact that I've already washed them and used them on the bed once, I'd return them. They are THIN, SMALL and pilled quite a lot. I've loved flannel sheets for decades; these are the worst I've ever had. The color wasn't an issue as long as they'd have been covered up by blanket/quilt, but any other use for them makes a color I don't care for, into an issue.
